assets.name: sky-paper
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: the existing Cloudtop Hotel paper sky background. Create a clean background plate by removing ALL clouds, islands, trees, houses, windmills and waterfalls. Fill their former areas with the same saturated azure-blue paper as the existing empty center. Preserve the blue color, tactile handmade paper fibers, very subtle mottling and lighting. Entire image must be uninterrupted blue paper sky, edge to edge, no objects, no white haze, no text, no border. Portrait 2:3 composition. This clean plate will sit behind separately animated scenery in the game.

assets.name: scenery
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target/style source: Cloudtop Hotel's detailed origami sky. Create a transparent game sprite atlas of SIX isolated scenery objects lifted from this world, recomposed fully visible with no clipped edges. 3 columns by 2 rows of six equal SQUARE cells, overall landscape 3:2 ratio, no visible grid or labels. Every object fits within its own cell with 10% clear margin on all sides. Row1 left to right: (0) floating green grassy island with faceted slate-blue hanging rock, several folded evergreen trees, a tiny cream cottage with red roof and a narrow bright blue folded-paper waterfall; (1) similar floating island with a tiny cream windmill with brown paper blades and a short blue waterfall; (2) smaller floating island with only a grove of evergreen trees. Row2 left to right: (3) wide fluffy white faceted origami cloud with soft lilac shadows; (4) smaller pair of layered origami clouds; (5) big white origami cloud with dramatic folds. Match the source closely: rich saturated colored cardstock, visible fibers, miniature craft realism, dimensional paper folds and soft internal shadows, same lighting. Actual transparent alpha background around every object. No blue sky, no ground, no cast shadows outside objects, no words, no hotel, no interface. Each island INCLUDING waterfall must fit completely into its square cell; clear space between cells.
